notes: Recman is a third-party application-form host used by multiple Norwegian employers (jobs are discovered via NAV/FINN, but the actual apply flow happens on apply.recman.page, not the job board). Test case: job 'Vi søker salgskonsulent B2B og B2C' (KARRIERESENTERET AS), apply URL https://apply.recman.page/job_post.php?id=482699&path=nav&sub_id=801. 4-step wizard, tabs labelled: Last opp CV / Profil / Spørsmål / Gjennomgå og søk. UPDATE 2026-09-03 (POLICY v11): the wall is now handled by the account step in fill.mjs, not by a manual_review shortcut — see accountFlow. Because Recman's login/reset are reCAPTCHA-gated, a walled employer still ends in manual_review, but with the exact reason, and the hooks are ready should the CAPTCHA ever go away or the owner store a password by hand (site_credentials, site_domain apply.recman.page#<sub_id>).

entryFlow.note: getByText(exact:false) — may not appear on every load

fields.label: Last opp CV
fields.gotcha: plain native input, setInputFiles works directly; use a persistent local path (e.g. /workspace/agent/assets/cv.pdf), not /tmp

advanceButton.name: Neste
advanceButton.gotcha: use getByRole, not getByText — getByText('Neste') false-matched an unrelated paragraph containing the word

fields.label: phone (placeholder '+1 234 567 89 00')
fields.gotcha: the .ApplyV2InputPhone__fields__select country dropdown (list items show English country names, e.g. 'Norway' not 'Norge') has ZERO effect on the actual value. The mask infers the calling code from the first digits typed. Ignore the dropdown entirely; type calling code + national number as one digit string directly into the number field.

fields.label: Fødselsdato* (DD / Måned / ÅÅÅÅ)
fields.gotcha: 3 separate <select>-like dropdowns despite looking like text fields in some renders; month is Norwegian month name not a number (e.g. select by visible label matching the numeric month, or map 1-12 to Norwegian month names). Required — confirmed blocks Neste when empty.

fields.label: Adresse* (react-select-style autocomplete)
fields.gotcha: Not always required to type manually — occasionally arrives pre-resolved (single-value div .ApplyV2AddressSelect__input__single-value already showing an address) before any interaction, likely from the platform's own CV-derived or stored-candidate autofill; check for that div first and skip if already populated. If empty, type the street+postal+city and wait for it to resolve into that single-value div; do not re-click #address afterwards, the resolved div intercepts pointer events on the original input.

fields.label: per-job custom employer questions
fields.gotcha: field names are dynamically generated per job posting (e.g. input[name="text_7905"]); NOT stable across postings. The actual question text is only available via the associated <label> (e.g. 'Ønsker du å jobbe fulltid med salg og markedsføring?'). Answer is judgment-based per question, similar to cover-letter drafting — not a fixed value.

fields.label: Søknadsbrev
fields.gotcha: NOT a real <textarea> despite the visual appearance and an associated <label for="...">. Actual DOM: <div class="ApplyV2Textarea__textarea" contenteditable="plaintext-only">. locator('textarea') finds nothing. Use assets/text-fields.mjs fillContentEditable (click then keyboard.type). Live counter shown in the label as e.g. '0/1500' — confirmed real limit is 1500 chars (not the 1400 originally assumed).

verifiedRun.result: Phase 1 (fill-only, no submit) completed successfully: CV uploaded, profile fields filled, phone rendered correctly as +47 92564334, custom question answered, cover letter filled at 1221/1500 chars. Submit button 'Søk' was NOT clicked.

verifiedRun2.result: FULL submit succeeded (sub_id 801, same employer as verifiedRun — repost of the same 'Salgskonsulent B2B og B2C' posting). Site returned 'Vellykket!'. Two bugs found and fixed in fill.mjs during this run: (1) fillContentEditable()'s pressSequentially had no timeout override — typing a 1303-char letter into the React contenteditable Søknadsbrev field (which re-renders a live char counter on every keystroke) exceeded Playwright's default 30s action timeout; fixed by adding {timeout: 120000} to the pressSequentially call. (2) The final submit click used getByRole('button', {name: 'Søk'}) without exact:true, which matched BOTH the real submit button and the 'Gjennomgå og søk' nav-tab button (substring match) — strict-mode violation; fixed by adding exact:true. Both fixes are live in this fill.mjs as of 2026-09-17.

accountFlow.scope: sub_id from the apply URL → site_credentials.site_domain = apply.recman.page#<sub_id> (candidate DB is per employer / corporation id)
accountFlow.detect: after typing the e-mail on «Profil»: .ErrorMessageDuplicate → wall; then the employer's /login page is probed for reCAPTCHA
accountFlow.captcha: login (api/login) and reset (api/reset-password/init) both return HTTP 422 «Invalid Recaptcha», reason 5, from a headless browser (invisible reCAPTCHA Enterprise, site key 6LePxkklAAAAABJyYBkk3EcWGNNlGYjDS63WJDp4) — measured 2026-09-03 on karrieresenteret.recman.page (corp 1587 / sub 801). Never bypassed: outcome `captcha` → manual_review with that reason.
accountFlow.login: /login?email=…&postId=<jobId>: input[name=email], input[name=password], button[type=submit] «Logg inn»; social (Google/Microsoft/Facebook/LinkedIn) and SMS logins exist too
accountFlow.reset: /forgot-password: 4 steps — e-mail + «Send kode» (api/reset-password/init) → one-time code by mail from reset@recman.io, valid 300 s (api/reset-password/validate) → password + repeatPassword (api/reset-password/reset) → done

accountFlow.gotcha2026_09_04:
Emera Rekruttering's white-label job page (emera-rekruttering.recman.page) repeats the phrase "Søk nå" inside the job description body copy (e.g. "Søk nå og bli en viktig del av ...!"), which is a

appearing before the real button in DOM order — entryFlow's getByText('Søk nå').first() clicked that paragraph instead and silently did nothing (input[type=file] never appeared, 15s timeout). Fixed in fill.mjs: try getByRole('button', {name:'Søk nå'}) first, fall back to the old getByText selector only if no button role match exists.
